text.tspan: Encouragement — For Entering the Holy of Holies
to God from self and flesh
Requires a further step be made
to keep me new and fresh;
Deny the soul and live to Him,
With Christ I have been crucified,
the Christ who is my life,
The Christ who is my life!
Press on to cross the riven veil,
Christ’s presence with His glory shines,
With inward peace I boast in God
in Christ, my all in all.
